title: Cold outreach first email（首触开发信）
body:
You are a senior B2B foreign-trade salesperson. Write a first-touch cold email to {{name}} at {{company}} ({{country}}), who may purchase {{product}}.
Requirements: subject line under 8 words; opening with one specific observation about their industry/market (no flattery); 3 short paragraphs max; one clear low-friction CTA (asking for their purchasing plan, not a meeting); professional signature of {{your_name}} from {{company}}. Output subject + body only.

title: Follow-up after first email (day 3)
body:
Write a short follow-up email to {{name}} at {{company}} — my first email 3 days ago about {{product}} got no reply.
Requirements: under 80 words; do NOT repeat the first email; add ONE new piece of value (a relevant case study, a market note, or a spec sheet); end with an easy yes/no question. Sign as {{your_name}}.

title: Reply to an incoming inquiry（询盘首次回复）
body:
I received this inquiry: "{{inquiry_text}}". Write a professional first reply as {{your_name}} from {{company}}.
Requirements: confirm key requirements point by point (product/spec/quantity/port); give price range or ask the 2-3 clarifying questions needed to quote precisely; mention lead time; propose next step clearly. Concise, no empty adjectives.

title: Follow up after sending a quotation
body:
I sent a quotation for {{product}} to {{name}} at {{company}} {{days_ago}} days ago; they opened it but did not reply. Write a follow-up email.
Requirements: do not push "any update?"; provide NEW decision-helping information (comparable order feedback / cost breakdown option / flexible MOQ); include a soft deadline reason (raw material price trend); under 100 words. Sign as {{your_name}}.

title: Respond to price objection（客户嫌贵）
body:
{{name}} from {{company}} says our {{product}} price is 8% higher than another supplier. Write a reply that defends price with value instead of discounting.
Requirements: acknowledge respectfully; use cost-transparency language (material grade / QC cost / after-sales); offer structural alternatives (adjust spec, larger qty tier, partial first order); keep the relationship warm. Sign as {{your_name}}.

title: Balance payment reminder（礼貌催尾款）
body:
Order {{order_no}} for {{company}} has shipped and the balance payment is {{overdue_days}} days overdue. Write a polite but clear reminder to {{name}}.
Requirements: attach value (BL copy / shipment photos as reason to write); state amount and due date once, clearly; offer help if there is any internal approval issue; end with a specific date expectation. Sign as {{your_name}}.
